question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Absurd
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Absurd"** means something that is wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate. (बेतुका)

 
 
• **Example: **The idea that the earth is flat is** absurd.**
 
 
 
• **"Realistic" **refers to having or showing a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected. (यथार्थवादी)
 
 
• **Example: **It's important to have **realistic **goals in life.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Absurd' **is **'Realistic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Salient **(प्रमुख): Most noticeable or important.

 
 
• **Example:** The salient features of the project were discussed in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Asinine **(मूर्खतापूर्ण): Extremely stupid or foolish.
 
 
• **Example: **His asinine behavior was not appreciated by his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Inept** (अयोग्य): Having or showing no skill; clumsy.
 
 
• **Example:** His inept handling of the situation only made things worse.
 
 

3a:Tab7,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
